NewsArticle.Title: Server Reboot
NewsArticle.Content: 04.04 11:55 PDT A Dark Ages server rebooted unexpectedly. Service resumed immediately, but rebooted unexpectedly a few times until stabilized at 20:16 PDT. This is the first unexpected Dark Ages reboot in over 4 months (last unexpected reboot: [99.11.28](http://www.darkages.com/2000/news/991128t.html)), which may be an graphic online game stability world record. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
